_comment: Curated list for AI recommendations (owner: Рома). The model may only choose from and describe these places; it never invents places or coordinates.

description.ru: Крепость XVI века над слиянием Оки и Волги.
description.en: A 16th-century fortress above the Oka and Volga confluence.

description.ru: Лестница-«восьмёрка» от памятника Чкалову к Волге.
description.en: A figure-eight staircase from the Chkalov monument down to the Volga.
The main pedestrian street of the historic centre.
The point where the Oka meets the Volga.
An embankment for walks along the Volga.

description.ru: Старая торговая улица с особняками купцов и банков.
description.en: An old trading street with merchant and bank buildings.

description.ru: Монастырь на высоком берегу Волги в стороне от туристических потоков.
description.en: A monastery on the high Volga bank, away from tourist crowds.

description.ru: Дом, где прошло детство Максима Горького.
description.en: The house where Maxim Gorky spent his childhood.

description.ru: Улица со старыми деревянными и каменными домами.
description.en: A street with old wooden and stone houses.
A merchant mansion on the Verkhne-Volzhskaya embankment.
